name: fitai-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions for FitAI Gemini proxy and trial management

scripts.test: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config test/firebase.json --only firestore --project demo-fitai "node --test test/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config test/firebase.json --only firestore --project demo-fitai "node --test test/emulator/*.test.mjs"
